 Wasserstein Releases Bird Feeder Camera Case - Compatible with Top Selling Smart Cams 
 Wasserstein unveiled the Bird Feeder Camera Case, now compatible with the Blink Outdoor, Ring Stick Up Cam, Wyze Cam V3, and Wyze Cam Outdoor. The Case features a smart camera and bird-feeder design, which provides a unique perspective of backyard bird life, while also offering a camouflaged housing for outdoor security cameras. 
 The Bird Feeder Camera Case is durable, weather-resistant, and easy to install. This ensures maximum protection for an outdoor camera that delivers high-quality footage. The Bird Feeder Camera Case is perfect for bird enthusiasts and nature lovers who want to capture the beauty of birds up close, thanks to a best-in-class smart home camera. 
 Wasserstein founder and CEO Christopher Maiwald said the Bird Feeder Camera Case is the company’s unique take on making dedicated bird-watching cameras. Their aim is to provide an affordable and unique alternative to homeowners that seamlessly integrates with existing smart home cameras. 
 Copy of Original Press Release 
 NEWS PROVIDED BY
 Wasserstein   
 Jan 30, 2023, 09:17 ET
 Wasserstein's Latest Release Combines the Power of Industry's Top Smart Cams with the Thrill of Bird Watching 
 LOS ANGELES ,   Jan. 30, 2023   /PRNewswire/ -- Wasserstein, the top provider of smart home accessories in the US, has launched its Bird Feeder Camera Case, compatible with the Blink Outdoor, Ring Stick Up Cam, Wyze Cam V3, and Wyze Cam Outdoor – and allows customers to get exclusive, up-close photos and videos of birds using their favorite smart cam.
 The   Wasserstein Bird Feeder Camera Case   allows users to:
 Repurpose their favorite smart home cameras for bird watching
 Connect to a live feed and watch birds as they eat in real-time
 Instantly share photos and videos of birds with your family, friends, and followers
 Connect to the Wasserstein solar panel and continuously power your smart cam
 Wasserstein's Bird Feeder Camera Case demonstrates the company's commitment to providing a unique user experience for the industry's top smart cams.
 "We're excited to provide customers with a unique product that is fun for the whole family! With our Bird Feeder Camera Case, you get up-close photos and videos of birds as they come to feed. We noticed the popularity of dedicated bird watching cameras and when we reviewed them, we noticed that they either had relatively poor camera technology or were too expensive. So we did what Wasserstein does best and found a way to integrate your best-in-class smart home camera for a new use case with the help of a Wasserstein accessory," said   Christopher Maiwald , Founder and CEO of Wasserstein. 
 Wasserstein's latest products, including the   Bird Feeder Camera Case   and   Bird Feeder Camera Case + Smart Cam bundles , can be found on the   Wasserstein website   and on   Amazon .

results.text:
How to install a camera into Wyze Bird Feeder – Wyze 
 Skip to main content 
 Articles in this section
 Introducing Wyze Bird Feeder 
 Wyze Bird Feeder Quick Start Guide 
 Wyze Bird Feeder Installation Guide 
 How to install Wyze Solar Panel onto Wyze Bird Feeder 
 How to wall mount your Wyze Bird Feeder 
 How to tree mount your Wyze Bird Feeder 
 How to suction cup mount your Wyze Bird Feeder 
 How to cord mount your Wyze Bird Feeder 
 How to install a camera into Wyze Bird Feeder 
 How to add bird food to Wyze Bird Feeder 
 See more 
 To install a camera on Wyze Bird Feeder:
 Slide the lens bracket over the camera lens
 If you have a Wyze Solar Panel installed, connect the power cable to the camera.
 Wyze Battery Cam Pro and Wyze Cam Outdoor require this connection to work with the solar panel.
 Mount the camera onto the camera bracket from the bird feeder, pulling the cord through the hole.
 Use a screw from the mounting kit to secure the camera to the bracket.
 Mount the camera bracket onto the main body of the bird feeder.
 If you have a Wyze Solar Panel installed, connect the power cable from your camera to it now.
 Last, manually adjust the camera's viewing angle using the Wyze app.
 Wyze Bird Feeder is compatible with:
 Wyze Battery Cam Pro
 Wyze Cam Outdoor v1/v2
 Wyze Cam v3/v3 Pro/v4
 Follow along with the video below for how to add a compatible Wyze Cam to Wyze Bird Feeder.
